verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is a model/API platform rather than an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no first-party MCP server or endpoint. OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility, use as a backend model in agent tools, function calling and the DeepSeek Harness preview are adjacent capabilities and are not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
